day name: Conception of the Honourable and Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptizer John.
title: , Forerunner and Baptist of Christ
name: John
troparia: (Tone 4) Joy to you, O barren one unable to give birth.* Behold, you conceive today the one who is really a torch of the Sun* who will enlighten the whole world that suffers from blindness.* Rejoice, O Zechariah, and cry out in all confidence:* The one who will be born is a prophet of the Most High.
kontakia: (Tone 1) Great Zechariah rejoices with his all-glorious wife Elizabeth,* for she has conceived John the Forerunner* whom the angel announced in gladness.* As for us men, let us honor him** as an initiate of grace.
